bearerAuth.description: Scoped agent token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

cloudflareAccess.name: Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion
cloudflareAccess.description:
Compact RS256 JWT assertion injected by a protected Cloudflare Access
Tunnel. The server validates its signature, issuer, expiration, and
configured UI/API application audience before using its signed email
claim. Generic reverse-proxy identity headers are never accepted.
